description: Start a sequence: its leads are enrolled and steps begin going out on the sending schedule, from the user's own LinkedIn account. The first call returns how many people it reaches and whether messages are reviewed first; it only starts with confirm: true. With section, resumes just that section after stop_sequence (also confirmed first when the sequence is running). Needs LinkedIn connected and the sending schedule on (see get_account_status).

confirm.description: Set to true only after the user agreed to what the first call (without it) said would happen.

section.description: One section of the sequence, as get_sequence lists it (sourceId and sourceName; leave both out for leads added manually)

name: start_sequence
title: Start or resume a sequence
